paras: Application: 2022+ Honda Civic Type R (FL5) Part Type: Fuel pump hanger (1–3 pumps, pumps not included) Part Number: 20-1090, 20-1092

The Radium Engineering fuel pump hanger for the 2022+ FL5 Honda Civic Type R is a drop-in upgrade that accepts one, two or three aftermarket fuel pumps and reuses the OEM fuel level sensor. Hardware is supplied to configure the hanger for one to three pumps, so some components will not be used depending on the setup.
hl: Drop-In Installation: Reuses the OEM fuel level sensor
1–3 Pumps: Hardware supplied for one, two or three pumps
Merged Outlet: 10AN ORB (7/8"-14) female pump-out port with low-profile 8AN male fitting
Return Inlet: 6AN ORB (9/16"-18) female with low-profile SAE quick connect so the factory feed line can be reused as the return
Fuel Starvation Protection: Collector with three 355LPH one-way fill valves and return-fuel replenishment
High-Current Electrical: Anti-rotation stainless studs, hermetically sealed serviceable connections
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Pump Hanger for Honda Civic Type R FL5 2022+
